name: Trading bot swap function guarded by a hardcoded code
summary: An unverified trading bot's swap function 0x229e9756 authorised callers only by checking a fixed code argument equal to keccak256("1205060227"), then approved the router and swapped its own balance with caller-chosen token, fee and pool parameters. The attacker flash-borrowed AIXBT, seeded narrow one-sided AIXBT/USDC and AIXBT/WETH Uniswap V3 positions, made the bot swap its 6,002.76 USDC and 2.30 WETH into them, and withdrew the positions.
notes: The bot's 592 earlier calls of 0x229e9756 all came from its operator 0x9422df61 (slot 4); the anchor is the first call by anyone else. A call with any other code reverts with "!code" (eth_call at the block before).
